test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Kalaimamani awards are given in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kalaimamani is the highest civilian award in the state of **Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• These awards are given by the Tamil Nadu **Iyal Isai Nataka Mandram** (literature, music and theatre), a unit of the **Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Tamil Nadu, to acknowledge artists in the state for their attainment.**
 
• **Susheela and Jamuna Rani and Bharatanatyam artistes Ambika Kameshwar and Parvathi Ravi Ghantasala** have been named for the Puratchi Thalaivi Dr J. Jayalalithaa Special Kalaimamani Awards for 2019 and 2020 by the Tamil Nadu government.
 
• The Tamil Nadu government has appointed dancer **Chitra Visweswaran** as the** secretary of Tamil Nadu Iyal Isai Nataka Manram.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75ddcb91df1e234c610ce472894bf8bb4a1116610c5b27a9f33545b9210b19a7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​ **The Global Indian Music Academy Awards** are presented annually by **Global Indian Music Academy to honour and recognise Indian music.**
